identity.title: Prove second producer conformance without source-specific governance

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Prove Ailuros is not an EverRun-specific validator by adding one minimal non-EverRun producer fixture that uses the same runtime evidence package, import, projection, authority, signals, and governed outcome path with zero source-specific governance branches. Dependency: 8029.add-governed-outcome-classification.
human_pressure.why_now: No Framework Left Behind is a product claim that requires evidence. EverRun dogfood is the reference producer, but one producer is insufficient proof of framework neutrality. The second producer should be a thin synthetic/generic MCP-style execution fixture, not a new integration project.
do_not_misread: Do not integrate OpenAIRE, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, or another external framework in this pack.
Do not add a plugin framework or adapter registry.
The goal is conformance proof using the existing contract, not ecosystem breadth.
red_lines: Do not weaken the evidence contract to make the fixture pass.

machine_core.goal: Add a minimal second-producer evidence fixture and end-to-end conformance test that traverses the existing generic Ailuros pipeline unchanged.
red_lines: Do not weaken the evidence contract to make the fixture pass.
invariants: Depends on: 8029.add-governed-outcome-classification. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Same validator/import/projection/signal/outcome code paths are used for EverRun and the second producer.
Unknown producer-specific event types remain preserved according to the contract.
contracts: Core governance logic must remain source-neutral.
failure_semantics: If the second producer requires producer-name branching in core governance, reject the pack and surface the contract gap rather than adding the branch.
Unknown source event types remain preserved/covered as unknown, never silently dropped or treated clean.

steps.title: Create minimal second-producer fixture
details: Use a generic MCP-style tool execution or workflow event set with a distinct source name and no planner/coder/judge vocabulary requirement.
Include lifecycle, action target, validation/result evidence, and one nonblocking warning or review case sufficient to exercise governed outcome.

steps.title: Run existing package validation/import
details: Use the exact same public/package functions or CLI path used by EverRun packages.
No producer-specific preprocessing inside Ailuros core.

steps.title: Run existing projection/governance path
details: Assert lifecycle, authority, signal, and governed outcome are produced through current generic logic.
Assert unknown producer-specific event is preserved rather than lost.

steps.title: Lock anti-regression
details: Test or static assertion fails if core modules add source-name branching for this fixture.
Document that real external adapters/integrations remain deferred.

acceptance: Second-producer fixture passes the same contract and import path as EverRun evidence.
Governed outcome is produced without modifying src/ailuros core for producer identity.
At least one producer-specific unknown event is preserved and does not become clean evidence.
Framework-neutral claim now has two-producer test evidence.
validate: python -m pytest tests/test_second_producer_conformance.py tests/test_runtime_evidence_contract_v1.py tests/test_evidence_package_ingest.py tests/test_authority_governance.py tests/test_governed_outcome.py -q

must_check: No src/ailuros core file changed solely to recognize the second producer.
Test proves source neutrality rather than merely validating fixture JSON shape.
reject_if: Any source == second_producer / source == everrun style governance branch is introduced.
A new adapter/plugin framework is added.
Contract validation is weakened to accept malformed evidence.
Unknown evidence is silently dropped or treated as clean.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Two-producer framework-neutral conformance using existing package/import/projection/governance code paths.
